definitions.explanation: A person given to daydreaming or unrealistic fancies, often someone whose ideas are impractical. Can be mildly critical (out of touch with reality) or admiring (imaginative).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{空想家|くうそうか}だ。
examples.english: He has always been a dreamer.

examples.japanese: {空想家|くうそうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{現実的|げんじつてき}→現実的：04794_genjitsuteki⟧な⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{対比|たいひ}→対比：12417_taihi⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My dreamer older brother is often contrasted with his realistic younger brother.

examples.japanese: ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空想家|くうそうか}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われていた→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{後|のち}→後：03545_nochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Her ideas, once dismissed as those of a mere dreamer, were later realized.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{空想|くうそう}→空想：00256_kuusou⟧ (fantasy, daydream) + ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (a suffix for a person characterized by something).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空想家|くうそうか}: a mere dreamer
- {大|だい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空想家|くうそうか}: a great fantasist

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {夢想家|むそうか}: dreamer; visionary — near-synonym, often more positive (an idealistic visionary)
- {現実家|げんじつか}: realist — antonym; a practical, down-to-earth person
